items.passage: On Saturday, Lily and her family go into town. First, they stop at the bank. Then they buy fruit at the market and eat lunch at a small restaurant. In the afternoon, Lily reads at the library. Her brother wants to see lions at the zoo, but Grandma needs to rest at home.
items.s4_0: We walk to the park after school.
items.s4_1: Mom buys apples at the market.
items.s4_2: The library is next to the museum.
items.s4_3: Please meet me at the station.
